# Generated by mods/cm_dev_perf/tools/buildings.py; not to be edited by hand.
# National Destinies' buildings in Construction Manager's Custom auto-build. Each one
# strictly meeting the author's criterion for a set is called from that set
# (cm_ab_custom_effects.txt); the rest of them, those that produce nothing, are the
# auto_build_nd list's, whose rows go to the player's own country's buildings.
# 34 capital, 7 market-centre, 89 control, 1194 for the list.

# The list. Rows stand for nothing until cm_perf_nd_assign_rows gives them a building; the
# placeholder keeps CMF's per-row walk from carrying the previous row's building into one that
# has none. Registration runs on every load, so a row's building is set only once. Root is the
# country.
cm_perf_nd_register = {
	cmm_register_settings_list = {
		mod_id = cm
		setting_id = auto_build_nd
		tab_id = ab_custom
		item_count = 30
		is_ordered = 1
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable_list = cm__auto_build_nd_i1_value } } cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 1 value = flag:cm_perf_nd_free } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable_list = cm__auto_build_nd_i2_value } } cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 2 value = flag:cm_perf_nd_free } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable_list = cm__auto_build_nd_i3_value } } cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 3 value = flag:cm_perf_nd_free } }

# Gives each of this country's buildings a row the first time the country qualifies for it (the
# potential of the advance that unlocks it), in National Destinies' own order, and never takes
# it back: a tag change only adds rows. Root is the country.
cm_perf_nd_assign_rows = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cm_perf_nd_rows_used } } set_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_rows_used value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_or_had_tag = ADU }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_madrasa }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_acequia }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_alcazar }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_funduq }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_ribat }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_hammam }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_dar_al_sinaa }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_waqf }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_suq }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_or_had_tag = ADU has_variable = nd_adu_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_bayt_al_hikma }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_adu_dar_al_jihad }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_or_had_tag = AEG }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aeg_shaduf_network }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aeg_maydan }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aeg_coptic_monastery }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aeg_nubian_mint }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_or_had_tag = AEG has_variable = nd_aeg_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aeg_suez_canal }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_or_had_tag = AHM }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_ahm_paik_office }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_ahm_buranji_archive }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_ahm_maidam_complex }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_ahm_namghar }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_ahm_dockyard }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_ahm_satra }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_or_had_tag = AIA }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aia_incense_warehouse }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aia_falaj_system }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aia_hajj_caravanserai }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aia_coffeehouse }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aia_desert_qasr }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aia_entrepot }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aia_modern_port }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_or_had_tag = AIA has_variable = nd_aia_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aia_caliphal_diwan }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_aia_trade_exchange }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = nd_air_formed }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_air_caravanserai }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_air_banco_mosque }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_air_salt_depot }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_air_desert_watchtower }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_air_desert_madrasa }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_air_trade_exchange }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = nd_air_formed has_game_rule = nd_destinies_enabled }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_air_war_camp }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_air_grand_caravanserai }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_or_had_tag = ALG }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_alg_zawiya }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_alg_khayr_al_din_mole }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_alg_bordj }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_alg_andalusi_aqueduct }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_alg_haouch }

		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_yua_baishin }
		cm_perf_nd_assign = { bt = nd_yua_mamba_datsan }
	}
}

# Root is the country. $bt$ = the building type. Kept small: it is pasted once per building.
cm_perf_nd_assign = {
	building_type:$bt$ = { save_scope_as = cm_perf_nd_t }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_rows target = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } }
			var:cm_perf_nd_rows_used < 30
		}
		set_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_label value = flag:$bt$ }
		cm_perf_nd_place_row = yes
	}
}

# The next free row gets scope:cm_perf_nd_t, labelled with var:cm_perf_nd_label (the
# building's own key, which is its name). Root is the country.
cm_perf_nd_place_row = {
	change_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_rows_used add = 1 }
	add_to_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_rows target = scope:cm_perf_nd_t }
	set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_new value = 1 }
	switch = {
		trigger = var:cm_perf_nd_rows_used
		1 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 1 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i1_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		2 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 2 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i2_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		3 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 3 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i3_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		4 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 4 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i4_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		5 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 5 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i5_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		6 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 6 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i6_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		7 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 7 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i7_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		8 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 8 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i8_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		9 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 9 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i9_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		10 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 10 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i10_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		11 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 11 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i11_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		12 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 12 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i12_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		13 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 13 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i13_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		14 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 14 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i14_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		15 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 15 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i15_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		16 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 16 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i16_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		17 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 17 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i17_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		18 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 18 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i18_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		19 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 19 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i19_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		20 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 20 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i20_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		21 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 21 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i21_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		22 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 22 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i22_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		23 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 23 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i23_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		24 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 24 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i24_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		25 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 25 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i25_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		26 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 26 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i26_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		27 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 27 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i27_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		28 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 28 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i28_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		29 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 29 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i29_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
		30 = { cmm_set_list_item_value = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = 30 value = scope:cm_perf_nd_t } set_variable = { name = cm__auto_build_nd_i30_name value = var:cm_perf_nd_label } }
	}
	remove_variable = cm_perf_nd_label
}

# New rows first, then each row shown while its building can be built (or a later tier of it
# can), as CM shows its own roster. Root is the country.
cm_perf_nd_refresh_rows = {
	cm_perf_nd_assign_rows = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_cm__auto_build_nd }
		cmm_for_each_list_item = { setting = cm__auto_build_nd effect = cm_perf_nd_row_visibility }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_local_variable = cm_perf_nd_new }
		cm_rebuild_auto_build_lookups = yes
	}
}

# Callback for cmm_for_each_list_item. Root is the country.
cm_perf_nd_row_visibility = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_rows target = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					can_build_building = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value
					building_type_is_obsolete = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value
				}
			}
			cmm_show_list_item = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = $i$ }
		}
		else = {
			cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = $i$ }
		}
	}
	else = {
		cmm_hide_list_item = { mod_id = cm setting_id = auto_build_nd item = $i$ }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = no }
		cmf_suppress = { v = $setting$_$i$ }
	}
}

# Appends the rows that have a building to the roster's lookups, which
# cm_rebuild_auto_build_lookups has just rebuilt from CM's own list, with the same fields and
# the same scaling. Root is the country.
cm_perf_nd_merge = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = cmm_list_items_cm__auto_build_nd }
		cmm_for_each_list_item = { setting = cm__auto_build_nd effect = cm_perf_nd_merge_row }
	}
}

# Callback for cmm_for_each_list_item. Fields in registration order: 1 enabled, 2 in_subjects,
# 3 min_control, 4 min_discount. Root is the country.
cm_perf_nd_merge_row = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_perf_nd_rows target = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value } }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = cm_ab_building_types_list target = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value }
		# Read as CMF's own _cmm_build_list_*_item read them: every field has its default from
		# registration on, so the cmm map holds each key.
		set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fk value = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f1 }
		if = {
			limit = { "variable_map(cmm|local_var:cm_perf_nd_fk)" >= 1 }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = cm_ab_building_types_enabled target = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fk value = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f2 }
		if = {
			limit = { "variable_map(cmm|local_var:cm_perf_nd_fk)" >= 1 }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = cm_ab_building_types_in_subjects_enabled target = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value }
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fk value = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fv value = "variable_map(cmm|local_var:cm_perf_nd_fk)" }
		change_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fv multiply = 0.01 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = cm_min_control_by_building_type key = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value value = local_var:cm_perf_nd_fv }
		set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fk value = flag:$setting$_i$i$_f4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fv value = "variable_map(cmm|local_var:cm_perf_nd_fk)" }
		change_local_variable = { name = cm_perf_nd_fv multiply = 0.01 }
		add_to_variable_map = { name = cm_min_discount_by_building_type key = scope:cmm_list_current_item_value value = local_var:cm_perf_nd_fv }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { always = no }
		cmf_suppress = { v = $setting$_$i$ }
	}
}
